$comment: Coverage thresholds + the staged-waiver mechanism for plan-staged WUs. Read by orchestrator agents and CI. Updated post-WU1 of Tabbed Chat (#51) to codify the per-WU exception protocol.

enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST check coverage against these thresholds before marking any task complete or creating a PR. If coverage drops below any threshold, the task fails — UNLESS the module is listed in stagedWaivers.modules below AND its minimalChecks are satisfied.

stagedWaivers.$comment: Modules whose coverage is intentionally below threshold because their executable bodies (e.g. factory stubs) land in a later work unit per an approved implementation plan. Each waiver is conditional on minimalChecks being satisfied. The orchestrator MUST remove a waiver when the WU(s) in filledBy land and the module's coverage meets the global thresholds. Final pre-PR comprehensive review must confirm stagedWaivers.modules is empty OR every remaining entry is justified with a post-merge follow-up.

stagedWaiverProtocol: 1. A waiver MAY be added when a WU lands a stubbed or types-only module whose executable bodies are deferred to later WUs by the approved implementation plan.

2. The waiver entry MUST specify: stagedBy (WU + commit + issue), filledBy (list of WUs that fill in the bodies), since (date), reason, minimalChecks (the concrete coverage-equivalent assertions that DO land in the staging WU).
3. minimalChecks MUST be satisfied by the WU's tests — they substitute for full body coverage by exercising stubs, selectors, error projections, smart-ctor negative branches, and record-construction.

4. When an implementing WU (in filledBy) lands, the orchestrator MUST recompute coverage for the module. If coverage now meets the global thresholds, the waiver entry is removed in that WU's commit. If not, the entry may stay with a recorded reason.
5. The final pre-PR comprehensive review MUST verify stagedWaivers.modules is empty OR every remaining entry has a documented post-merge follow-up.
6. Project-wide HPC totals are informational only; the per-module 100% threshold remains the target for non-waived modules.
